name: Chu x Chu Idol 2 -Melodies x Memories-
source:
This is the sequel to ChuxChu Idol. Some years later, the popular idol Chuchu is missing! With the entertainment world in confusion, Chuchu’s ‘sister’ Chuuno Churam takes the stage for her debut under the same name. But she has a secret! She’s actually the combined form created when a female student Yukino and a vampire Ruuchu kiss. Having accidentally seen them kiss, Daigo is forced to be her servant.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/10/01/october-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《Chu×Chu Idol》的续篇。多年后，人气偶像Chuchu失踪，演艺界陷入混乱。Chuchu的“妹妹”Chuuno Churam以相同名义登台出道，但她隐藏着一个秘密！她其实是女学生Yukino与吸血鬼Ruuchu接吻后融合形成的姿态。Daigo意外目睹二人接吻，被迫成为她的仆人。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/10/01/october-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
